description: React functional component for displaying, managing, and interacting with a list of devices. It includes loading, deleting, pinging devices, and navigation features.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the device list from the API and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the device ID to be deleted, triggering confirmation dialog.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Deletes the device after user confirmation and updates the device list.

methods.name: handlePing
methods.description: Pings a specific device and updates its status in the device list.

methods.name: handleRefresh
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the device list.
